{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:Star_system_hologram.jpg|thumb|250px|A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a star system]]
{{Quote|There are so many! Do they all have a system of planets?''"<br />"''Most of them.''"<br />"''Has anyone been to them all?''"<br />"''Not likely.''"<br />"''I want to be the first one to see them all.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], looking at the stars|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
A '''star system''', also known as a '''planetary system''' or simply a '''system''', was a group of bodies orbiting one or more [[Star/Legends|stars]].
Star systems usually consisted of one or more [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and the debris remaining from the formation of the primary planets and central star, such as [[Comet/Legends|comets]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].

There were 7,100,000,000 stars in [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]], with approximately 3,200,000,000 habitable star systems. Only about a billion of these systems had life. Only 69,000,000 of those systems met population requirements for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] representation. All star systems were given [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|coordinates]] that were used by [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputers]] to permit space travel.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Flying from the center of a star system to its further limits at sublight speeds took from 12 to 72 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], depending on the size of said system and the potential obstacles along the way.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

The galactic standard approach to naming star systems was to base the name on the central star or planet.<ref name="Reidi Artom's Expansion Manifesto">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040115manifesto|text=Reidi Artom's Expansion Manifesto}}</ref> However, some systems were unnamed and had only a numerical designation.<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
